text:
sam-eng: Deploybot just blocked the release for v3.14.0. Gate: SBOM signature missing + vuln scan shows one low-severity transitive CVE. What's the recommended path?

deploybot: [automated] release v3.14.0 -> gate: SBOM_SIGNATURE: MISSING; VULN_SCAN: 1 LOW (transitive). Block action: HOLD. See /pipelines/9876.

olivia-sec: Can someone paste the SBOM verify output? need to know if it's an unsigned artifact or just cosign metadata not attached. regulatory wants evidence for EU customers.

maria-ml: I pulled the artifact: `cosign verify --key ksm://proj/sbom-key registry.redwood/v3.14.0` -> `error: no signatures found`.

kevin-release: Timeline constraint: we have a 2hr change window starting 18:00 UTC. If we stall past that, rollback might hit dependent job windows. Suggest timeboxed decision: either pin transitive dep or quick rollback to v3.13.9.

olivia-sec: How noisy is the low CVE? If it's transitive and not exploitable in our runtime we can pin and ship with an internal ticket to remediate. Need approval from Sec and Compliance for that.

maria-ml: The vuln is in a test helper package used only in the build container, not in runtime. Looks safe to me. I can open a remediation PR to remove the dep from build image.

sam-eng: So two asks: (1) get a Compliance sign-off for shipping with unsigned SBOM + explanation, (2) decide pin vs rollback. Can we fast-track a compliance exception?

olivia-sec: Compliance: we can approve a timeboxed exception if we attach an evidence doc and a remediation plan within 48 hours. Need release notes to include: reason, risk assessment, rollback plan, and ticket link.

kevin-release: Proposed ops path: 1) Pin transitive dep in build image (non-prod canary) + attach interim SBOM note to release notes, 2) Request Compliance exception with evidence (build logs + `cosign` output), 3) Continue rollout to EU region in a limited canary (5%). If anything weird, automatic rollback policy stands.

sam-eng: I can produce the evidence bundle. Command I ran: ```bash
registry-cli fetch-artifact manifest v3.14.0 --sbom > sbom.json
cosign verify --key ksm://proj/sbom-key sbom.json || true
sha256sum sbom.json > sbom.sha256
```

maria-ml: I'll open the remediation PR and add the pinned transitive dep (sha) and a note. Link coming in 5m.

deploybot: [automated] note: if you proceed with pin, set release tag `timeboxed-sbom-exception` and schedule automated follow-up to failover to v3.13.9 after 48h if remediation not merged.

olivia-sec: Approving conditional path: Compliance OK if you 1) add release note with risk, 2) attach evidence bundle to ticket, 3) set automated rollback guard at 48h. Send me the ticket link and I'll sign.

kevin-release: I'll create CHG-4021 with the evidence + rollout plan and add the 5% EU canary config. Sam/maria, paste links here when ready.

sam-eng: Evidence uploaded: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-4021/evidence.zip. Release notes draft: "v3.14.0: shipping with unsigned SBOM due to cosign propagation delay; low-risk transitive CVE in build-only dependency; remediation PR #3598 filed; rollback scheduled +48h."

maria-ml: PR #3598: https://git.redwood/infra/containers/pull/3598 pinned test-helper@sha256:abcd1234.

olivia-sec: Reviewed evidence, added sign-off comment on CHG-4021. :white_check_mark: Keep the canary throttled to 5% and monitor error/latency for 2 hours post-rollout.

kevin-release: Rolling to limited canary now per approved path. Tagging release `v3.14.0-canary-timeboxed-exception`.

deploybot: [automated] rollout started -> canary 5% EU -> policy: timebox 48h -> auto-rollback target: v3.13.9 if remediation not merged.

sam-eng: Thanks all. Will watch metrics and ping if we see anomalies.

olivia-sec: Please remember to attach the `cosign` logs to CHG-4021 and mark remediation ETA in the ticket.

kevin-release: Closing thread for now, will update CHG and release notes post-monitoring.
